evidence.text: For AdS5 Kerr, exploit monotonic j(a) and the increasing r_H(a) on the large branch, allowing r_H to serve as a proxy for angular momentum. Eliminate a from the temperature equation to obtain the simpler rational expression for specific entropy in equation (36).

evidence.text: Compute entropy from horizon area and divide by physical mass. At fixed mass, use the first law to explain the entropy sign; at fixed temperature, eliminate mass with the horizon equation and study the resulting horizon-radius and specific-entropy functions.

sources.title: Universal thermodynamic relations with constant corrections for rotating AdS black holes

evidence.text: Does the previously proposed entropy–extremality relation hold for rotating BTZ and Kerr-AdS black holes under a constant action correction, and is there an analogous relation involving the shift of angular momentum?

sources.title: Thermodynamic extremality relations in massive gravity

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation extend to charged topological black holes in higher-dimensional massive gravity, and are there corresponding relations involving pressure, charge and massive-potential parameters?

sources.title: Universality on thermodynamic relation with corrections in de Sitter black holes

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality response relation hold for de Sitter black holes under a small cosmological-term correction, particularly at the outer–cosmological horizon merger, and what does this suggest about the WGC?

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation on higher-dimensional black hole with arbitrary cosmological constant

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation retain its form for higher-dimensional charged Reissner–Nordström black holes with positive or negative cosmological constant, including extremal and Nariai limits?

sources.title: The validity of the universal relation between corrections to entropy and the extremality of Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes under the GUP and EUP

evidence.text: Within the authors' GUP and EUP prescriptions for Schwarzschild–de Sitter horizons, does the entropy–extremality relation survive the Nariai limit, and can matching conditions remove any discrepancy?

sources.title: Universality of thermodynamic relation with corrections in Einstein-Bel-Robinson gravity black holes

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy/extremality relation extend to black-hole thermodynamic quantities with nonlinear dependence on a deformation parameter η, including situations in which several state variables respond to η simultaneously?

sources.title: Universal thermodynamic relations with constant corrections for rotating AdS black holes

evidence.text: Define extremality by T=0. For BTZ, substitute the extremal entropy into the mass. For Kerr-AdS, solve the resulting quartic entropy equation and select S1; the text identifies S2 as negative and S3,S4 as imaginary.

sources.title: Thermodynamic extremality relations in massive gravity

evidence.text: Solve the corrected mass formula for ε and differentiate with respect to entropy, pressure, charge or an individual ci while fixing the stated other variables. Multiply inverse derivatives by their conjugate potentials and compare with the extremal mass derivative.

sources.title: Universality on thermodynamic relation with corrections in de Sitter black holes

evidence.text: Obtain the perturbed mass from the horizon equation, invert to ε(S,M,Q), differentiate at fixed mass and charge, and combine with the temperature before taking the zero-temperature endpoint limit.

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation on higher-dimensional black hole with arbitrary cosmological constant

evidence.text: Impose T=0 to obtain explicit five-dimensional limiting entropies. For unspecified D, compare the general entropy-dependent expressions without explicitly solving the dimension-dependent extremality condition.

sources.title: The validity of the universal relation between corrections to entropy and the extremality of Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes under the GUP and EUP

evidence.text: Solve uncertainty inequalities, select a branch, identify position uncertainty with a horizon diameter, and apply the area law and surface-gravity temperature at the resulting horizon. Rearrange residual factors into matching equations whose solutions are examined.

sources.title: Universality of thermodynamic relation with corrections in Einstein-Bel-Robinson gravity black holes

evidence.text: Direct implicit differentiation compares horizon-radius responses at fixed mass with those at fixed entropy, keeping P and β fixed. Substitution into derivatives of M and S produces the entropy form of the proposed relation.

sources.title: Probing black holes extremality bounds with non-extensive entropies

evidence.text: Does the Goon-Penco relation between entropy variations and extremal mass variations survive logarithmic and non-extensive entropy replacements, when either their characteristic parameters or the AdS curvature parameter is varied?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture, black branes and violations of universal thermodynamics relation

evidence.text: Does the entropy/extremality relation attributed to Goon and Penco extend to three modified-gravity black-brane models under a small constant action deformation? The charged example is also used to discuss the direction of charge-to-mass corrections relative to the WGC.

sources.title: Universal relations with the non-extensive entropy in the RPS and CFT framework

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation survive Barrow, Rényi and Sharma–Mittal entropy replacements for charged AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter, in both restricted phase space and CFT thermodynamics?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture of charged-rotating-AdS black hole surrounded by quintessence and string cloud

evidence.text: Does a small constant perturbation of the cosmological term preserve entropy–extremality relations for charged rotating AdS black holes, including quintessence and string-cloud extensions, and produce additional conjugate-variable identities or WGC-like mass shifts?

sources.title: Proof of the Weak Gravity Conjecture from Black Hole Entropy

evidence.text: Under what assumptions do higher-dimension operators increase black-hole entropy at fixed mass and charge, and can the resulting coefficient bounds enforce a positive extremality shift and the weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation on black branes with arbitrary cosmological constant

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco thermodynamic relation extend to higher-dimensional Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton black holes throughout the event/cosmological-horizon coexistence region, and to rotating cylindrical or toroidal black branes when several thermodynamic variables respond to a cosmological perturbation?

sources.title: Universal Relation between Corrections to Entropy and Extremality

evidence.text: How are changes in extremal energy and entropy related when a theory's dynamics are perturbed, and under what conditions does positive entropy correction imply a lower extremal black-hole mass at fixed other extensive variables?

sources.title: Universal thermodynamic extremality relations for charged AdS black hole surrounded by quintessence

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation survive a constant cosmological-term deformation for charged AdS black holes surrounded by quintessence, and can analogous relations involve the quintessence normalization and magnetic charge?

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation on rotating charged black strings with arbitrary cosmological constant

evidence.text: Does the Goon-Penco energy-entropy relation extend to rotating charged black strings with cylindrical horizons, particularly when angular momentum, charge and other thermodynamic state variables depend on the cosmological-constant perturbation η?

sources.title: Stability of Extremal Black Holes and Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Kiselev Spacetime

evidence.text: How do small cosmological-constant-related perturbations affect extremal black-hole thermodynamics and WGC-based stability, and does charged-scalar scattering preserve entropy increase and weak cosmic censorship in quantum-corrected RN-AdS Kiselev spacetime?

sources.title: Higher-derivative corrections to black hole entropy at zero temperature

evidence.text: What is the classical higher-derivative entropy shift of a charged black hole at exactly corrected zero temperature, and does its sign constrain the extremality shift as the fixed-mass entropy shift does?

sources.title: Thermodynamic extremality in Power-law AdS black holes: a universal perspective

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation survive a small cosmological-term perturbation in Power-Maxwell, Power-Yang–Mills and Maxwell-Power-Yang–Mills AdS black holes, and what sign trends resemble Weak Gravity Conjecture expectations?

sources.title: Quantum corrections and extremality: a generalized universal relation

evidence.text: How does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation change when black-hole entropy is an invertible general function of horizon radius, including logarithmic or exponential corrections?

sources.title: Higher-Derivative Corrections to Entropy and the Weak Gravity Conjecture in Anti-de Sitter Space

evidence.text: How do four-derivative interactions change AdS-Reissner-Nordström extremality and microcanonical entropy, and what Wilson-coefficient constraints follow if entropy corrections are positive for thermodynamically stable black holes?

sources.title: Universality on the thermodynamic relation with corrections in higher-dimensional de Sitter black holes

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality response relation extend to higher-dimensional de Sitter black holes, to approaches along either horizon toward both mass endpoints, and to ensembles allowing charge and angular momentum to shift with the perturbation?

sources.title: The emergence of universal relations in the AdS black holes thermodynamics

evidence.text: Does a small constant deformation of the cosmological term reproduce entropy–extremality relations across selected AdS black holes, extend them to other thermodynamic conjugates, and support a WGC-like interpretation of corrected mass-to-charge behavior?

sources.title: Universal relations with the non-extensive entropy perspective

evidence.text: Does the thermodynamic relation between entropy corrections and the extremal mass bound survive replacing Bekenstein–Hawking entropy by five nonextensive entropy prescriptions for a charged AdS black hole? Can an entropy-dependent multiplicative factor restore it?

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation of accelerating black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation hold for accelerating four-dimensional AdS black holes after a cosmological-constant perturbation, and what matching of that perturbation to the conical-deficit parameter is required?

sources.title: Dark dimension gravitons as dark matter

evidence.text: Can gravitational production from a hot Standard Model brane supply viable dark matter in the dark dimension, while relating its abundance to the dark-energy scale?

sources.title: Dark dimension gravitons as dark matter

evidence.text: Numerically solves coupled Boltzmann equations for individual KK abundances, including brane production, decays back to Standard Model fields, and intratower daughter production. Early production also receives an analytic treatment using Bessel-function kernels.

sources.title: Dark dimension gravitons as dark matter

evidence.text: Dimensional analysis of universal graviton–stress-tensor coupling estimates brane-to-bulk production. The expansion-compensated quantity y=ρKK/s gives production dominated by the initial temperature, conditional on approximate preservation of dark-sector mass.

sources.title: Leading order effective operators in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Which leading effective interactions between Standard Model and hidden-sector matter are actually generated by tree-level and one-loop gravity, and what follows for dimension-five portals, ultralight scalar dark matter and matter symmetries?

sources.title: The Cosmophenomenology of Axionic Dark Radiation

evidence.text: Can rare interactions of energetic, nonthermal axionic dark radiation affect BBN, produce dark matter after thermal freeze-out, and leave an observable cosmic axion background?

sources.title: Hidden photon and axion dark matter from symmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can the thermal breaking of a hidden continuous symmetry produce sufficiently cold light axion-like or hidden-photon dark matter through dark-Higgs oscillations, once Higgs-portal interactions, thermal blocking, and dissipation are included?

sources.title: Saturon Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can maximal microstate entropy enable direct quantum production of macroscopic dark matter from homogeneous thermal radiation, and enhance finite-temperature bubble nucleation?

sources.title: Parametric Resonance Production of Ultralight Vector Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can a displaced dark Higgs transfer its condensate energy into vectors through parametric resonance early enough to produce ultralight dark matter satisfying relic-abundance and coldness constraints?

sources.title: Cosmological Bounds on sub-GeV Dark Vector Bosons from Electromagnetic Energy Injection

evidence.text: What constraints do BBN photodissociation and CMB power and frequency spectra place on long-lived sub-GeV dark vectors when detailed electromagnetic injection spectra, nonuniversal cascades and thermal freeze-in production are included?

sources.title: Hidden Charged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can exact hidden charge conservation stabilize thermal dark matter while satisfying relic-abundance, small-scale structure, enhanced-annihilation and halo self-interaction constraints?

sources.title: Dark Matter meets Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Which minimal thermal dark-matter models admit an asymptotically safe gravity–matter embedding, and what restrictions do the resulting Planck-scale boundary conditions place on low-energy portal couplings and dark-matter masses?

sources.title: Moduli induced cogenesis of baryon asymmetry and dark matter

evidence.text: Can late modulus decay generate both visible baryon asymmetry and asymmetric dark matter at GeV-scale reheating, while conserving baryon number at the fundamental vertices and explaining ΩDM/ΩB ≈ 5?

sources.title: Thermal Relics in Hidden Sectors

evidence.text: Can cosmologically allowed hidden sectors support thermal dark matter with the WIMPless mass–coupling relation, and how do unequal sector temperatures affect radiation constraints, freeze-out and the viable mass range?

sources.title: Schwinger dark matter production

evidence.text: Can inflationary Schwinger production alone generate the observed dark matter abundance, including light charged particles whose purely gravitational production is negligible, in a secluded dark sector that never thermalizes?

sources.title: Dark Matter Relics and the Expansion Rate in Scalar-Tensor Theories

evidence.text: Can thermal dark matter reproduce the assumed observed abundance with annihilation cross sections larger or smaller than standard-cosmology values, through scalar-tensor modifications of pre-BBN expansion?

sources.title: Dark matter from mediator decay in early matter domination

evidence.text: How strongly does production from thermal on-shell mediator decays constrain dark matter in histories containing early matter domination, particularly when production occurs during its adiabatic stage or an earlier radiation era?

sources.title: Axion-like Dark Matter Mediators

evidence.text: Can a weakly coupled DFSZ-like axion-like mediator reproduce the observed dark-matter abundance while dark matter remains thermally decoupled from the Standard Model, and which experimental constraints probe the viable production regimes?

sources.title: Gravitino thermal production revisited

evidence.text: What gravitino thermal production rate follows after correcting earlier analytical and numerical treatments of the one-loop thermal self-energy, and what abundance and reheating constraints follow?

sources.title: Nonthermal production of dark radiation and dark matter

evidence.text: Can nonthermal production reconcile dark matter with detectable visible-sector interactions and sufficiently cold dark radiation, while generating both baryonic and dark matter asymmetries?

sources.title: Polynomial inflation and dark matter

evidence.text: Can a minimal renormalizable extension of the Standard Model jointly realize small-field inflation, Higgs reheating, and the observed abundance of nonthermal fermionic dark matter, without a nonminimal gravitational coupling?

sources.title: Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis and Gravitino

evidence.text: How do light-element abundances constrain unstable gravitinos and reheating, or the properties of long-lived NLSPs when the gravitino is stable, after updating production, decay showers and charged-particle bound states?

sources.title: Dark matter production mechanisms with a nonthermal cosmological history: A classification

evidence.text: How can relic dark-matter production be classified and its abundance approximated when a pre-BBN modulus-dominated era reheats visible and dark sectors with potentially different temperatures?

sources.title: Light Higgsino Dark Matter from Non-thermal Cosmology

evidence.text: Can late reheating after an early matter-dominated era yield the observed abundance of light higgsino dark matter, and what detection prospects and string moduli mass hierarchies support this possibility?

sources.title: Dark matter of any spin -- an effective field theory and applications

evidence.text: Can massive particles of arbitrary spin be treated perturbatively using only physical components, and can a neutral Higgs-portal realization account for dark matter through freeze-out or freeze-in while satisfying the bounds used in the paper?

sources.title: Dynamical Dark Matter from Strongly-Coupled Dark Sectors

evidence.text: Can dark ensembles with Regge spectra and exponentially growing Hagedorn degeneracies realize the abundance–lifetime balancing required by Dynamical Dark Matter, and what initial cosmological restrictions follow from their aggregate abundance and effective equation of state?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: How does time variation of a weak connection between a dark Abelian sector and hypercharge affect dark-matter production?

destination.title: Expansion, reheating and relic histories
destination.question: How do reheating, altered expansion and entropy release change relic production, and what can relics and other observables reveal about those histories and inflation?
destination.summary: Connects abundance calculations to cosmological evolution while separating matter domination, modified gravity, vacuum domination and stasis.

Original proposal qualification: Production during adiabatic matter domination or a preceding radiation era is explicitly distinguished. Independent challenge qualification: Keep the adiabatic matter-dominated stage distinct from a preceding radiation era.

sources.title: Dark Matter Relics and the Expansion Rate in Scalar-Tensor Theories

evidence.text: Can thermal dark matter reproduce the assumed observed abundance with annihilation cross sections larger or smaller than standard-cosmology values, through scalar-tensor modifications of pre-BBN expansion?

sources.title: Dark Matter Relics and the Expansion Rate in Scalar-Tensor Theories

evidence.text: Insert the resulting Jordan-frame expansion rate into the Boltzmann equation for Y = nχ/s̃ and x = mχ/T̃. For masses 5–1000 GeV, tune the annihilation cross section to Ω₀ = 0.27, the abundance target adopted in this historical analysis.

sources.title: Dark Matter Relics and the Expansion Rate in Scalar-Tensor Theories

evidence.text: Numerically solve the conformal scalar master equation, or the coupled scalar–Einstein-frame Hubble equations for disformal coupling. Incorporate departures from radiation's equation of state using a Standard Model particle-threshold kick function.

sources.title: Beyond the Standard Model Cocktail

evidence.text: Can entropy dilution permit thermal or would-be thermal dark matter substantially above the standard freeze-out mass bound, and can cosmic-string gravitational waves probe the associated early matter or vacuum domination?

sources.title: Moduli induced cogenesis of baryon asymmetry and dark matter

evidence.text: Can late modulus decay generate both visible baryon asymmetry and asymmetric dark matter at GeV-scale reheating, while conserving baryon number at the fundamental vertices and explaining ΩDM/ΩB ≈ 5?

sources.title: The First Three Seconds: a Review of Possible Expansion Histories of the Early Universe

evidence.text: Which departures from radiation domination are physically motivated, how do they affect relics and primordial structure, and what observations constrain them before or after BBN?

sources.title: Supersymmetry, Nonthermal Dark Matter and Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can constraints on nonthermal MSSM neutralino dark matter determine the duration of a post-inflationary matter-dominated phase and thereby sharpen predictions for the scalar tilt and tensor-to-scalar ratio?

sources.title: Anomalous EDGES 21-cm signal and a moduli dominated era

evidence.text: Can freeze-out during an early modulus-dominated era, followed by entropy dilution, reconcile photon-mediated millicharged DM with the fractional abundance needed in the paper's EDGES interpretation?

sources.title: Dark matter from mediator decay in early matter domination

evidence.text: How strongly does production from thermal on-shell mediator decays constrain dark matter in histories containing early matter domination, particularly when production occurs during its adiabatic stage or an earlier radiation era?

sources.title: Generality and persistence of cosmological stasis

evidence.text: How general and persistent is matter-to-radiation cosmological stasis across the full space of species decay rates and initial abundances, and which spectra favor longer duration beyond previously studied power-law models?

sources.title: Constraining Non-thermal Dark Matter by CMB

evidence.text: Can the minimum early-matter-domination duration needed to obtain the dark-matter abundance with ⟨σann v⟩<3×10^(−26) cm³ s^(−1) be reconciled with inflation-dependent upper limits from the scalar spectral index?

sources.title: Polynomial inflation and dark matter

evidence.text: Can a minimal renormalizable extension of the Standard Model jointly realize small-field inflation, Higgs reheating, and the observed abundance of nonthermal fermionic dark matter, without a nonminimal gravitational coupling?

sources.title: Nonthermal hot dark matter from inflaton or moduli decay: Momentum distribution and relaxation of the cosmological mass bound

evidence.text: How does the nonthermal momentum distribution of sterile particles produced during an early matter-to-radiation transition affect CMB and linear matter spectra, and how much can it relax the physical mass constraint on a subdominant hot dark matter component?

sources.title: Dark matter production mechanisms with a nonthermal cosmological history: A classification

evidence.text: How can relic dark-matter production be classified and its abundance approximated when a pre-BBN modulus-dominated era reheats visible and dark sectors with potentially different temperatures?

sources.title: The Moduli and Gravitino (non)-Problems in Models with Strongly Stabilized Moduli

evidence.text: Under what stabilization and reheating conditions can a heavy Polonyi sector avoid excessive entropy production and gravitino-mediated neutralino overproduction, while possibly supplying the dark matter abundance?

sources.title: Light Higgsino Dark Matter from Non-thermal Cosmology

evidence.text: Can late reheating after an early matter-dominated era yield the observed abundance of light higgsino dark matter, and what detection prospects and string moduli mass hierarchies support this possibility?
